recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. A future cleanup effort may review obsolete unreferenced terminology source files such as valueset-condition-status-present.xml, but editing that residue is not necessary to reconcile FHIR-7617.
issue_request: FHIR-7617 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 Condition. It asked whether systems really distinguish Working from Confirmed in Condition.clinicalStatus and resolved to drop working, use provisional instead, and use an extension if differentiation is really needed.
initial_application: The historical application is git commit 0a6643ad139240e0f578cbe596e007d6c516df3e, 'Split Condition.status {#7581} {#7617} {#7864}', which split Condition status into clinicalStatus and verificationStatus and changed examples with clinicalStatus='working' to active clinical status plus differential verification status.
additional_context: FHIR-7581 and FHIR-7864 define the same broader split between lifecycle clinical status and verification status, and FHIR-7851 documents the corresponding v2 mapping distinction. Current source has further evolved: Condition.clinicalStatus contains lifecycle concepts such as active, recurrence, relapse, inactive, remission, resolved, and unknown, while Condition.verificationStatus contains unconfirmed, provisional, differential, confirmed, refuted, and entered-in-error. The old source/condition/valueset-condition-status-present.xml file still contains a working concept, but it is not referenced by current Condition bindings, is not listed in fhir.ini as a current standalone value set, has only an OID reservation reference, and build.fhir.org returns 404 for its page/json.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current authoritative Condition definition and generated CI page already omit working from Condition.clinicalStatus and retain provisional as a verificationStatus concept.
